summary: A Sourcey v3.8.3 generated documentation site for the maintained third-party Go library github.com/stretchr/testify, built from the upstream source tree at the pinned public commit 87a7b9d57689f6579db2da795ab8deeab29cb724 (MIT licence) and published at the durable URL https://testify.anonymux.org/. The site renders 711 exported API entries across the five public packages (assert, require, mock, suite, http), taken from 18 non-test source files, every source link on the site pinned to the same commit. The build is reproducible from a committed godoc.json snapshot, so the publishing host needs no Go toolchain, and the generated receipt seals the run. The site is published at the publisher's own domain as part of the Anonymux Docs catalogue.

observations.what: The documented surface clears the twenty-public-API floor by a wide margin, measured two independent ways.
observations.method: Comparison of the Go toolchain godoc snapshot (711 entries) against an independent source-level parse of the same tree (714 exported symbols)
observations.value: 711 entries rendered (assert 327, require 311, mock 46, suite 21, http 6) from 18 non-test source files; the independent source parse counts 714. 710 of 714 carry a doc comment (99.4%). The upstream tree ships 9 runnable Example functions for the whole public API, which is the gap the coverage page quantifies.

observations.what: The run is sealed by a signed Runx receipt and the receipt verifies clean.
observations.method: runx verify <receipt-id> against the locally sealed receipt tree, plus a public copy of the receipt bytes for re-verification

The receipt binds three opaque evidence references with sha256 digests: the pinned source tarball, the godoc snapshot, and the published landing page at testify.anonymux.org.

observations.value: Pull request #1996 against stretchr/testify (master), opened from ASporeTeam/testify:spore/sourcey-reference-docs, adding docs/sourcey/sourcey.config.ts and docs/sourcey/README.md. It documents the same build and the same measured coverage that this reference reports, and it lets the maintainers generate and host the reference themselves.

reproduction.note: A third party can rebuild the site without a Go toolchain and re-derive every number quoted above.
steps: sourcey godoc -m <pinned module dir> -p "./assert,./require,./mock,./suite,./http" --exclude "github.com/stretchr/testify/internal" -o godoc.json  (needs the Go toolchain; the produced snapshot is published with this evidence)
sourcey build -c sourcey.config.ts -o dist  (snapshot mode: no Go needed)
serve dist/ and compare against https://testify.anonymux.org/
reproduction.inventory_check: An independent source-level parse of the pinned tree reports 714 exported symbols and exits non-zero below twenty, so it cannot silently certify a thin reference.

receipt.verification: runx verify reports the 2-receipt tree valid with 0 findings; the same bytes are published at the public_bytes_url so a reviewer can re-verify them
receipt.verification_note: The Ed25519 public key that signed this receipt is published next to it (receipt-public-key.json), so a stranger can verify the signature and re-run 'runx verify' against the published bytes.
